notes.title: HOMESICKNESS — Patchnotes (5/26 - 6/1)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45547455/0abb5a92b00ff09bd846dfd6d9638e8f13d006c8.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

I wanted to go over some of the recent patches I have been actively working on; for those unaware. There is a lot to go over, and there are specifics I could have forgotten, But this is it so far;

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45547455/b860a138decf00de92c9247dbf8b1eedf9a973dc.png[/img]

[b]1.0.1 - 1.0.8[/b]

- Improved lockpad. Now upon discovering a spot locked up with a lockpad, a small lockpad icon will show up exactly where the door is located.

- Fixed an issue where the Telechord would break upon having the UI setting off.

- Performance improvements to Discord Rich Presence and Steamworks API.

- Major fixes to the four pages side mission; reported to me through the Community Hub (Discussions).

- Other minor fixes and polish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45547455/f83925e5f0591f8a19acbd589b0c61976b093398.png[/img]

I wanted to briefly thank everyone for the support and love given to this project. It has meant lots to me, and has served as a significant motivation boost for up and coming plans I'd like to invest into.

It honestly means the world. Hearing people resonate with the game, dropping genuine heartfelt reviews and such, and receiving love from across different spaces online has been great to see.

Thank you for your love for this project, and do be sure to share the word around! Reviews are open for anyone to share their thoughts. I'll be keeping an eye out, and be sure to keep an eye out too for a later post going over a couple of other things! :)
